description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) and request model classes for the 'Assets' feature within a data asset management backend project. It includes models for handling asset status logs, additional asset IDs, asset properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent input mappings, reporting attribute mappings, EF source mappings, throughput equations/scalars, and data input values. The classes primarily serve to model database tables and API request payloads with validation rules, normalization logic, and metadata annotations.

classes.name: AssetStatusLogDto
classes.description: Represents a persisted record of an asset's operational status log, mapping to the asset_status_log database table.

classes.name: CreateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Model for the request payload to create a new asset status log entry, including validation attributes.

classes.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Model for the request payload to update an existing asset status log entry, with validation rules.

classes.name: AdditionalAssetIdDto
classes.description: Represents additional identifiers for assets, mapping to the additional_asset_id database table.

classes.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new AdditionalAssetId, with required validation.

classes.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing AdditionalAssetId, with validation.

classes.name: AssetPropertyDto
classes.description: Models the asset_property database table, representing properties linked to assets.

classes.name: CreateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating asset property records, with validation attributes.

classes.name: UpdateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating asset property records, with validation.

classes.name: ControlDeviceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents mapping records between controls and devices from control_device_mapping table.

classes.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating control device mappings, with required fields.

classes.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating control device mappings, with validation.

classes.name: InputParameterDto
classes.description: Models the input_parameter database table for asset input parameters.

classes.name: CreateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Create request model with custom validation for input parameters, enforcing UOM and reporting program when active.

classes.name: UpdateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Update request model with similar validation for input parameters.

classes.name: ParentInputMappingDto
classes.description: Represents parent-child input parameter relationships.

classes.name: CreateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating parent input mappings.

classes.name: UpdateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating parent input mappings.

classes.name: ReportingAttributeMappingDto
classes.description: Models the reporting_attribute_mapping table for asset reporting attributes.

classes.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating reporting attribute mappings.

classes.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating reporting attribute mappings.

classes.name: EfSourceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents EF source mappings from ef_source_mapping table.

classes.name: CreateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Create request with normalization logic for EF source mappings.

classes.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Update request with normalization for EF source mappings.

classes.name: ThroughputEquationDto
classes.description: Models throughput_equation table records for throughput equations.

classes.name: CreateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Create request with validation and normalization for throughput equations.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Update request with normalization and validation for throughput equations.

classes.name: ThroughputScalarDto
classes.description: Models throughput_scalar table for throughput scalar data.

classes.name: CreateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating throughput scalar data, with normalization.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating throughput scalar data, with normalization.

classes.name: DataInputValueDto
classes.description: Represents data_input_value table records for input values.

classes.name: CreateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Create request for data input values.

classes.name: UpdateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Update request for data input values.
